must_fix.title: Empty styled .form-status box renders under the contact form before any submit
must_fix.evidence:
css/styles.css `.form-status { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--paper-deep); border-left: 4px solid var(--ink); }` applies to the always-present empty

in visit.html. Playwright probe at 360px on visit.html: $eval('#form-status', rect+bg+text) -> [328, 24, 'rgb(236, 226, 207)', ''], so a visible empty shaded bar with a dark left rule sits below 'Send enquiry' on every load (confirmed by screenshot). Fix: drop padding/border/background when :empty (keep the live region in the page) and add a test.

nits:
visit.html:

Opening hours

immediately followed by Opening hours, so it is read twice
index.html: #home-events <ul> stays rendered while empty when no events remain; events.js hides its list in the same case
README file layout: tests/run.mjs line is misaligned by one column
README suggests `npx http-server`, which downloads a package; `python3 -m http.server` is enough

report:
I found one thing to fix before merge: an empty shaded bar shows under the contact form's button on every visit. Everything else in the issue is met. All 31 tests in `tests/run.mjs` pass, and `git status` is as I found it. **What I checked** - **Tests:** `NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node tests/run.mjs` ends with `31 passed, 0 failed`. They cover shared chrome, links, no external requests, no overflow at 360px, headings and landmarks, focus rings, the mobile menu, the genre filter and its URL state (including bad `?genre=` values), event ordering and the empty case, form validation, and opening from `file://`. - **The issue's requirements:** - Four pages share the same nav, and `index.html` is at the repo root. - The catalogue has 16 books in 7 genres. - There are no CDNs or web fonts; fonts are system stacks only. - The visit page has hours, an address and a contact form. - **Extra probes:** - Opened from `file://`, clicking the Poetry filter works. The URL becomes `books.html?genre=poetry`, the count reads "Showing 2 of 16 books", and there are no console errors. - Pressing Escape with the menu closed does nothing. - The footer hours match the hours table. - No leftover or unrelated files. **Must fix** 1. **Empty status bar under "Send enquiry".** `css/styles.css` gives `.form-status` padding, a `--paper-deep` background and a 4px ink left border. The `

` in `visit.html` is empty until someone submits, but it still renders. In headless Chromium at 360px, loading `visit.html` and measuring `#form-status` gives `[328, 24, 'rgb(236, 226, 207)', '']`: 328px wide, 24px tall, shaded, with no text. A screenshot shows a dark-edged empty strip under the button. It looks like an unfinished alert. - **Fix:** apply the box styles only when there is text, for example `.form-status:empty { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; }`. Keep the element in the page and don't use `display: none`, so screen readers still announce the message when it appears. - Also add a test that the status box has no height before the form is submitted. **Nits** - The visit page says "Opening hours" twice: the `

` and the table `` directly under it, so screen readers hear it twice. The caption could be visually hidden or reworded. - If there are no upcoming events, the home page still renders an empty `
    `. The events page hides its empty list. - In the README file layout, the `tests/run.mjs` line has its description one column out of line with the rest. - The README offers `npx http-server` as a way to view the site.
